# Founder vision restatement — 2026-08-11

Source: the founder, verbatim, in a working session on 2026-08-11, with the directive
"restructure anything about this repo that doesn't fit the vision."

> **The Problem:** Today's autonomous agents fail at long-horizon execution because they
> drown in unbounded context, lacking the radical, biological-grade information
> compression necessary to filter signal from noise.
>
> **The Solution:** We are building an agentic harness that autonomously commissions its
> own reality-sensing architecture, dynamically compressing massive environmental data
> into targeted abstractions just as the human retina distills millions of ambient
> photons into conscious thought.
>
> **The Uniqueness:** By continuously recycling its own reasoning traces for self-repair
> and privatized post-training, the system generates an exponentially compounding
> informational moat that autonomously adapts and out-competes static models.

## What was done with it (context, not a verdict)

The README was restructured around this framing on 2026-08-11 (OST-Agent PR #106): the
compression discipline, the commissioned senses, and the trace-recycling machinery were
already built under other names and are now named as the product's identity, each scored
honestly. The two dated plans specifying the deleted evolutionary harness were removed.

## One collision, recorded rather than resolved

The vision's "privatized post-training ... autonomously adapts" outruns standing policy:
readiness criterion G4 says no policy evolves unattended, `no-evolvable-policy` pins it
in the test suite, and the genome — the one prior attempt at self-improving policy — was
removed for a measured reason (model-in-the-loop stochasticity swamps parameter-level
effects at affordable n). The traces the vision would train on ARE being harvested,
quote-verified and owned. Whether a training loop over them is worth building, and
whether "autonomously adapts" ever means adapting policy without a human, is a mandate
question for the founder — this note is demand evidence for it, not a finding that it
should happen.
